name: fee-estimate
title: Fee Estimate
description: Displays provider-calculated transaction fees with an itemized total, network and source context, observed timestamp, refresh, loading, and error states.
docs: Fee Estimate is provider-neutral and never calculates or invents fees. Populate it from an RPC, wallet, indexer, or backend response for the exact transaction message, and refresh whenever that message, its blockhash, or network conditions change.
